items.scope: Interactive protocol matcher on the canonical English homepage, including Protocol Feed-derived recommendation metadata and provenance presentation
items.reason: The German homepage is an independently authored localized surface and does not currently expose the English interactive matcher. No English matcher copy is silently rendered under /de/. This is an explicit experience-parity gap rather than a translation fallback.
items.release_rule: If the matcher becomes part of the declared German homepage contract, localize its labels and explanations from reviewed German data while preserving canonical protocol IDs, evidence state and provenance.

items.scope: Query Playground, Agent Evaluation, demos, integration kits, research articles and gaps, problem/topic/question collections, updates, evidence/trust utilities, contact/legal pages and other secondary human-interface routes
items.reason: These routes remain canonical English surfaces outside the declared German human-interface release. Localized pages must keep the English language boundary explicit; English-only secondary routes do not count as German localization coverage.
items.release_rule: If a secondary surface is promoted into primary German navigation or an exact German surface contract, add it to the locale contract and publish native German copy before retaining the same release claim.
